name: rumblewersfad
description: Unofficial fan launcher & stats companion for Rumbleverse (Rumblewersfad)
author: Rumblewersfad contributors

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n vite,tsc,electron "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --watch" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 dist/main/main.js && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && vite build && electron-builder --win nsis && node scripts/copy-setup.mjs
scripts.build:dir: npm run build:electron && vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --dir && node scripts/copy-setup.mjs
